blocks.text: DAT:000–022 DETAILED REVIEW AND DELEGATED APPROVAL — CANONICAL

The Data entity block was reconsidered from first principles under the standing delegated authority. The review compared five genuinely different architectures per root, scored 45 candidates across 360 criterion values, routed 113 English concepts without forced atomization, passed all 18 canonical packet checks, passed all 19 dedicated Data entity-layer soundness checks, and passed the complete authority regression. All deterministic generated forms remained unchanged.

Approved architecture: DAT:0xx names bounded information entities rather than physical media, acts of communication, or information-processing events. The inward triplet names one bounded datum maintained within one reference entity; the outward triplet names one bounded datum whose content denotes one distinct reference target; and the systemic triplet names one coordinated dataset shared across multiple participants in one information domain. The third trit changes only persistent, manifest, or dormant status.
DAT:000 — persistent internal datum — A persistent bounded information object maintained within one reference entity, independently of whether that information object is presently manifest.
DAT:001 — manifest internal datum — A bounded information object that is presently manifest within one reference entity.
DAT:002 — dormant internal datum — A bounded information object that remains maintained within one reference entity without being presently manifest.

DAT:010 — persistent target reference — A persistent bounded information object whose content denotes one distinct reference target, independently of whether that referential content is presently manifest.
DAT:011 — manifest target reference — A bounded information object whose content presently manifests a reference to one distinct reference target.
DAT:012 — dormant target reference — A bounded information object whose content denotes one distinct reference target without presently manifesting that reference.

DAT:020 — persistent shared dataset — A persistent coordinated collection of information objects maintained as one shared dataset across multiple participants in one information domain, independently of whether that dataset is presently manifest.
DAT:021 — manifest shared dataset — A coordinated collection of information objects that is presently manifest as one shared dataset across multiple participants in one information domain.

DAT:022 — dormant shared dataset — A coordinated collection of information objects maintained as one shared dataset across multiple participants in one information domain without being presently manifest.

Design boundary: these roots do not silently encode a physical storage or transmission medium; access, observation, belief, truth, communication, delivery, processing, mutation, provenance, authority, scheduling, probability, or modality. Persistent information identity may co-occur with manifest or dormant status; manifest and dormant are mutually exclusive for the same information entity at one reference time. Lexical dormancy remains distinct from runtime [2]/num uncertainty.
